summary: Frontend re-verification (iteration_5) of the 2 HIGH bugs fixed after iteration_4 for SOLEKICKS PK. Both fixes CONFIRMED working. (A) Flash Drop product card titles now render in dark color rgb(10,10,10) (text-obsidian) on white cards — clearly visible with product names 'Dunk Low Coastline Blue', 'Oasis Foam Recovery Slides', 'EQT Street Support ADV', 'AJ-1 Retro High Ember' shown along with price + strikethrough original price. (B) Mobile Quick Add button (product-card-mobile-add-{id}) is now VISIBLE by default (display:flex) at 390px, 767px, 820px (previously failing case), and 1023px, and correctly HIDDEN at 1024px and 1920px (lg:hidden). Clicking Quick Add at 820px successfully adds to cart (cart-toggle badge = 1, cart-drawer shows 'Your Bag (1)' with the correct product). Regressions passed: search-toggle opens centered modal with dark backdrop and search-input focused; /login and /register both show google-login-btn plus email/password form (auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit); admin login with sahilwaheed48@gmail.com / Admin@12345 redirects to /admin. Desktop hover quick-add overlay (product-card-add-btn-{id}) uses 'hidden lg:block' which is the correct paired CSS.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductCard.jsx breakpoint pairing is now internally consistent: mobile-add uses 'lg:hidden' and hover overlay uses 'hidden lg:block' — good, no gap between 768–1023px anymore.
Title now uses text-obsidian on white card bg — good contrast (rgb 10,10,10).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_5 confirmed both HIGH bugs from iter_4 are fixed. Verified: (1) computed title color rgb(10,10,10) on Flash Drop cards, (2) mobile-add visible at 390/767/820/1023, hidden at 1024/1920, (3) 820px click increments cart to 1, (4) search modal centered, (5) google-login-btn on /login+/register, (6) admin login → /admin. Testids used: product-card-title-{id}, product-card-price-{id}, product-card-original-price-{id}, product-card-mobile-add-{id}, product-card-add-btn-{id}, auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit, google-login-btn, search-toggle, cart-toggle, cart-drawer.
rca of the issue: Iter_4 bugs RCA (already fixed): (A) title used a color class that resolved to white — fixed by switching h3 to 'text-obsidian'. (B) mobile Quick Add was gated 'md:hidden' while desktop hover overlay used 'hidden md:block', creating a dead-zone at 768–1023px — fixed by aligning both to 'lg' (lg:hidden for mobile-add and 'hidden lg:block' for hover overlay), matching Tailwind's 1024px lg breakpoint.
